title: CSIR NGRI Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 21 Technician Posts
description: The National Geophysical Research Institute (CSIR NGRI) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 21 Technician Posts. Candidates who have completed their 10th Pass can grab this chance and apply for the CSIR NGRI Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
